# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster gains a vision of what will probably happen in the next minute if he
takes a specified action.
@@ 2
Caster can detect whether an unfulfilled fate, destiny, or wyrd lies upon a
person, object, or place.
@@ 3
As Intuitions I, except caster gazes 3 minutes into the future.
@@ 4
The caster can attempt to avoid one attack, which can be a missile or a melee
attack or a spell. The missile, weapon, or enemy spellcaster must be within
range and within the caster’s field of vision when this spell is cast. The
caster receives a bonus of +50 to his DB against missile, melee, and directed
elemental attacks; his normal DB against area elemental attacks, or the enemy
spellcaster suffers a -10 to his Base Attack Roll (for all other spell
attacks).
@@ 5
As Intuitions I, except caster gazes 5 minutes into the future.
@@ 6
Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. This
spell can only be used once per night, the caster must sleep a minimum of one
sleep cycle, and the caster must not be disturbed during the sleep.
@@ 7
Predicts most probable action of a being in the next round; specifics are not
learned (e.g., attack in melee, cast a spell; but no details on targets or
exactly what spell) This results in the caster being able to declare his
statement of intent for the round after hearing what the target has decided to
do. Note the target is free to change his declared action (with the requisite
penalties).
@@ 8
The caster is able (using the culturally specific apparatus) to make a
prediction concerning a person, place, or object. Using the apparatus to make
the prediction will take at least one minute per level of the spell. Only one
prediction may be made in any given 24-hour period by the caster (and a failed
spell counts towards this limit). The prediction will be accurate 25% of the
time plus 1% per level of the caster (otherwise, the results are random). The
prediction may not concern events further than one day per level of the caster
into the future. The predictions will be general, ambiguous and enigmatic. The
interpretation of the predictions is left entirely to the caster.
@@ 9
As Anticipations I, except if the action is to cast a spell, the exact spell
to be cast and the target are learned.
@@ 10
As Intuitions I, except caster gazes 10 minutes into the future.
@@ 11
As Dream I, except limit is 2 dreams per night on different topics.
@@ 12
As Divinations I, except the prediction may concern events up to 1 month per
level of the caster into the future.
@@ 13
As Anticipations I, except caster can either predict the most probable actions
of 3 beings in the next round or can predict the most probable actions of one
being over the next three rounds.
@@ 14
This provides an analysis of an unfulfilled destiny in terms of who made the
prophecy and/or the source of the destiny, the strength of the destiny, and
where appropriate the oracular riddle (or whatever) which encapsulates the
destiny. The spell does not indicate how a destiny may be fulfilled. Note that
this spell will reveal if a given prophecy or divination is a hoax-the
strength of the destiny will in such cases depend on the degree to which the
victim of the hoax believes in the divination.
@@ 15
As Intuitions I, except caster gazes 1 minute per level of experience into the
future.
@@ 16
As Dream I, except limit is 3 dreams per night on different topics.
@@ 17
As Divinations III, except the predictions may concern events up to 1 year per
level of the caster into the future.
@@ 18
As Anticipations III, except if any of the actions involve spell casting, the
spells to be cast and the targets are learned.
@@ 19
As Anticipations V, except caster can either predict the most probable actions
of 5 beings in the next round or can predict the most probable actions of one
being over the next five rounds.
@@ 20
As Dream I, except limit is 5 dreams per night on any combination of topics.
@@ 25
As Anticipations I, except caster can predict the most probable actions of
every being within 100'.
@@ 30
As Anticipations True, except if the actions are to cast spells, the spells to
be cast and intended targets are learned.
@@ 50
As Divinations I, except the prediction may concern events up to ten years per
level of the caster into the future.
